evidence.title: Softr AI Co-Builder
evidence.locator: Building a new app; requirements; modifying an existing app; current limitations
evidence.finding: Prompts create database structure, pages, access groups and visual blocks. Follow-up chat modifies the current app. The assistant can generate a custom-coded component through Vibe Coding; complex workflows and some system-page edits have documented limits.

evidence.title: Softr builder MCP connection
evidence.locator: Set up your client; authorization screen; personal access tokens; managing access
evidence.finding: External Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients can reach a Softr workspace through OAuth or a personal access token with user-selected project permissions. This is an external caller connection, not an embedded Claude Code or Codex coding harness.

evidence.title: Softr workspace account
evidence.finding: The browser dashboard has a workspace account menu and API Tokens. The documented MCP connection requires Softr account authorization.

evidence.title: Softr plan prices and recurring free allowance
evidence.locator: Plans at a glance; General comparison; AI credits FAQ; Free plan FAQ
evidence.finding: The page explicitly states USD and distinguishes monthly prices from annual equivalents. Free is free forever and includes five AI credits per month. Basic is $25 on monthly billing, versus $19 monthly equivalent paid annually. App-building via the user own MCP AI subscription appears under Pro and above in the current comparison; database/workflow MCP is also listed for lower tiers.

evidence.title: Softr platform customer license
evidence.finding: The platform is licensed to the customer for the agreement term under a limited non-transferable, non-sublicensable customer grant. Recognizable third-party/open-source components are excluded from that platform grant. This is the main service license, separate from ownership of generated customer products.

evidence.title: Softr dated product updates
evidence.locator: AI App Builder, November 10 2026; earlier October updates
evidence.finding: The dated November 10 announcement describes an AI app builder spanning frontend, database, permissions, workflows and integrations. It is a service update, not a versioned source release.

evidence.title: Softr official roadmap
evidence.locator: Planned, In Progress and Shipped columns
evidence.finding: The undated current board lists Brand kit as Planned and App Security Center as In Progress. AI App Builder, Airtable migration, record grouping and workflow credit usage are Shipped. Future cards are not used as current capability evidence.

evidence.title: Softr public community issues
evidence.locator: Ask the community topic list, activity dates
evidence.finding: The retrieved public list includes saving/editing questions and account/group-sync reports with November activity. These are user reports and question titles, not independently verified defects or product release commitments.
